seo.title: Nudge · Polite invoice reminders for freelancers
seo.description: Nudge sends friendly, well-timed reminders for your unpaid invoices so you get paid faster without writing awkward emails.

hero.headline: Get paid on time, without the awkward emails
hero.sub: Connect your invoices once. Nudge sends polite, well-timed reminders in your voice and stops the moment a client pays.

offer.title: Founder plan, one year
offer.item: One year of Nudge, every feature
bullets: Reminders written in your own tone
offer.note: We open to founder members first and set you up personally.

how.title: Set it up once, then forget it

steps.title: Connect your invoices
steps.body: Add the invoices you've sent, or forward them to your Nudge inbox.

steps.title: Pick your tone
steps.body: Friendly, firm or final. Nudge times each reminder for you.

steps.title: Get paid
steps.body: Reminders stop the moment the client pays. You just see the money arrive.

services.title: What's inside
services.intro: Everything you need to stop chasing, nothing you don't.

items.title: Smart timing
items.body: Reminders go out when clients actually read email.

items.title: Your voice
items.body: Edit every message so it sounds like you, not a robot.

items.title: Clear overview
items.body: See who owes what and what's coming in this month.

items.title: Client-safe
items.body: Polite by default, so relationships stay friendly.

items.title: Auto stop
items.body: The moment an invoice is paid, the reminders stop.

items.title: Private
items.body: Your client list stays yours. We never email them anything else.

about.title: Why we built it
about.body: Every freelancer we know has an invoice they're too embarrassed to chase. Nudge does the chasing politely, so you can keep the relationship and still get paid.

items.q: Will my clients know it's automatic?
items.a: The emails come from you and use your words. Most clients just see a polite reminder.
Any tool that can email a PDF invoice. Forward it to Nudge and you're set.

items.q: What happens after the first year?
items.a: Founder members keep the founder price for as long as they stay.
With Bitcoin Cash: scan the code with your wallet and your seat is reserved.

finalCta.headline: Stop chasing. Start getting paid.
finalCta.sub: Founder seats are limited to the first 200 freelancers.
